title: To be wooed and won
html_source:
Henry VI, Part 1 Act V, Scene 3:

She’s beautiful, and therefore to be woo’d;
She is a woman, therefore to be won.

anchor.prefix:
turning from Shottery and from her arms. 

1986#172

 Both satisfied. I too. 

 Don't tell them he was nine years old when it was quenched. 

1922#201

 And from her arms. 

 Wait
anchor.suffix:
. Ay, meacock. Who will woo you? 

 Read the skies. Autontimorumenos. Bous Stephanoumenos. Where's your configuration? Stephen, Stephen, cut the bread even. S. D: sua donna. Già: d
